ai._trap_2026_07: DB defaults: rank STUDENT, all stats 10 - a rank-less create is a paper doll. Writing rank triggers server-side stat REGENERATION overwriting explicit stats in the same payload (JONIN -> 556,520 base). Pin stats via a second edit. statsMultiplier is a dead lever past the 450k effective cap. rank/regeneration/preferredStat/preferredGeneral1/2 REQUIRED on create (guide 21 table).

bloodline.update.wholeRecord: BloodlineValidator has no .partial(): every non-optional field must be present on every update (same whole-record law as quests).
bloodline.update.stripNote: The update handler deletes rounds and friendlyFire from every effect object before writing (bloodline.ts:653-657). Bloodline effects are therefore permanent (no round expiry) and friendlyFire is meaningless on them; sending these fields is harmless but they never persist.
bloodline.update.nameDedup: Server rejects if another bloodline already has data.name ('Bloodline name already exists').
bloodline.update.sideEffects: actionLog row + Discord content webhook (prod only).

contracts.bloodline.get / getAll / getAllNames: standard read trio; getAllNames is the dedup source.

statClassification.notes: required by validator even though DB column is nullable

villageId.notes: nullable but the key must be present

effects.notes: SuperRefineEffects applies; rounds/friendlyFire stripped server-side (see contracts). Runtime targeting law: 46b R1.

bloodline.runtime: Effects realize at battle init, targetId = bearer, fromType 'bloodline'; suppressed entirely in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING (combat.ts:2696-2714). Polarity law 46b R1.

skillTree._status: SHIPPED ENGINE ENTITY (was proposal-only in 33_PROPOSAL_skill_tree.md). Full staff CRUD + player purchase economy live in source.

skillTree.update.wholeRecord: Handler rebuilds the full column set from input.data: whole-record on every update. No effect-field stripping (unlike bloodline): rounds/friendlyFire persist on skill effects, and friendlyFire is load-bearing for ALLIES/ENEMIES targets.
skillTree.update.nameDedup: Rejects duplicate name ('Skill name already exists'). Unique index SkillTree_name_key.
skillTree.update.fallbacks: image falls back to IMG_AVATAR_DEFAULT if empty; folderId empty -> null.

contracts.skillTree.get / getAll / getAllNames: getAll is cursor-paginated (limit 1-500) + skillTreeFilteringSchema (name, effect[], tier, costSkillPoints, hidden, folderId).

skillTree.purchaseSkill.rules: hidden skills unpurchasable; all requiredSkillIds must be ACTIVATED; available = user.skillPoints - sum(costSkillPoints of activated skills); SPECIAL skillType must already exist in UserSkill (granted, e.g. by quest) before it can be activated; re-activation of a deactivated owned skill is free of a new row (unique userId+skillId).

contracts.skillTree.resetSkillPoints: player; deactivates all (COST_SKILL_RESET applies past free resets).

image.notes: empty falls back to IMG_AVATAR_DEFAULT on update

requiredSkillIds.notes: prereq skill ids; all must be activated to purchase

effects.notes: SuperRefineEffects applies. friendlyFire on each tag is load-bearing when target is ALLIES/ENEMIES (see runtime).

runtime.SELF: realized at battle init on the bearer only (fromType 'skill'). Polarity law identical to bloodline: offensive tags attack the bearer.
runtime.ALLIES_ENEMIES: deferred pass after usersState exists: every effect is realized against EVERY living combatant (bearer included), then filtered per-tag by checkFriendlyFire on the tag's friendlyFire field (FRIENDLY = same direction, ENEMIES = different, unset/ALL = everyone). target=ENEMIES with friendlyFire unset still hits the whole field. Source combat.ts:3071-3095, process.ts:140-169.
runtime.suppression: All skill-tree effects suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING (same clause as bloodline).

economyConstants.note: 100 total = 20 from leveling (levels 21-40) + 80 from quests. COST_SKILL_RESET 30; free resets: normal 0 / silver 1 / gold 2.
economyConstants.liveState_2026_08_01: RULED (Brandon): the skill TREE system is live but skill POINTS effectively do not exist in the live game yet. Source confirms why: the leveling grant (+1 per level-up event, Chunin+, L21-40, profile.ts:410-440) fires ONLY inside the level-up mutation with no retroactive backfill - players already past L40 get zero from leveling forever, and even mid-band players get +1 per future level-up with no catch-up to their expected total. The quest channel reward_skillpoints (rewards validator; payout clamped LEAST(current + n, MAX_SKILL_POINTS) at quests.ts:1778) exists and is unused - it is the content-side lever that activates the economy. 33_PROPOSAL v2 = content-fill of this entity + the reward_skillpoints emission plan.
